issues.problem: The English sentence ends with a truncated phrase: "the foreigners began to tell the story about" — the verb has no object, so the claim (外国乃稍稍传说之, that foreigners began spreading word of him/it) is left incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Change to "the foreigners began to spread the word about him."

issues.problem: English adds an explanatory gloss not in the Chinese: "Pasha — a title, roughly governor —" and "hoşbeg, or clan chief". The Chinese only gives 帕夏 and 和硕伯克 with no such definitions.
issues.suggestion: Either drop "a title, roughly governor" or add a matching gloss in the Chinese.

issues.problem: English inserts a cause not stated in Chinese: "men on the army rolls who could not also farm" as the content of 旧屯之弊; the Chinese only says "the abuses of the old garrisons".
issues.suggestion: Reduce to "the abuses of the old garrisons inside and outside the pass" or add the same explanation in Chinese.

issues.problem: English adds "talking of wealth and strength among themselves"; the Chinese only says the overseas powers 私议以为脆弱 (privately judged China frail), with no mention of discussing wealth and strength.
issues.suggestion: Drop "talking of wealth and strength among themselves" or render 私议 as "privately whispered".

issues.problem: English puts "only a stretch of empty outskirts" in quotation marks as a source quote, while the Chinese 我所得不过一荒郊 is unquoted narrative.
issues.suggestion: Remove the quotation marks around "only a stretch of empty outskirts" (or add 引号 in the Chinese).

issues.problem: Chinese opens with 作者推断, marking the standard as the author's inference; English states it flatly ("the two lines show one test"), though it later restores the hedge ("One reading is... The biography draws no such conclusion").
issues.suggestion: Open with "The author infers that, set side by side, the two lines show one test."

overall: The two editions are essentially aligned in facts, dates, quotes and hedging, with one truncated English clause to repair and a few English-only explanatory glosses to reconcile.
